I changed `app/session.py`, but I couldn't run anything to check it. Bash is disabled in this session, so the python -I check of `_precompact_policy` (claude, codex, unknown backend) is still to do. The project has no tests or test layout, so I added none.

- **Change:** `PRECOMPACT_MIN_CONTEXT_PCT` is now 30, and the Claude policy uses it for both `arm_threshold` and `min_context_pct`. A new `CODEX_PRECOMPACT_MIN_CONTEXT_PCT = 5` is used by the Codex policy. The comment above the constants now gives the 30% reasoning and says Codex stays at 5 because the finding was measured on Claude only.
- **Consumers:** Nothing else hard-codes 5. Both comparisons (arming near line 696 and firing near line 792) use `<`, so a compact at exactly 30% arms and fires, which puts it on the ≥30% side. Nothing in `session_turns.py`, `routes/sessions.py` or `chat.js` reads these values. I found no raw measurements anywhere in the directory, so the 35-38% and 78-86% figures are unverified here.
- **Threshold conflict:** `PRECOMPACT_CONTEXT_THRESHOLD = 20` is now below the Claude `arm_threshold` of 30. `context_threshold` is only copied into the timer payload and never compared against, so nothing breaks. I left it at 20, but it is now misleading in the logs.
